Robust and Cost-Effective Used 5 Colour Offset Printing Machine Price in India:

The offset printing industry has been flourishing every day with several new printing creations, changing the dynamics of the industry. One such creation that has definitely been transforming the industry is the multi-colored capabilities of offset printing machines. These machines have become quite a staple in the industry, equipping businesses with the ability to print more than one color at a time. Searching for a 5-color offset printing machine that can help you produce a high-quality outcome while being cost-effective? Well, Sneha Graphics & Solutions is here to cater to your printing needs!

We are a distinguished name in the industry when it comes to providing top-notch quality used 5 colour offset printing machine at a price that is quite competitive in comparison to others in the industry. All the machines that we offer are well-equipped with all the necessary technologies to offer versatility in the printing process. From printing non-woven bags to paper and several other materials, these machines come with several settings that can help you to get the desired outcome with cost-effectiveness per product. 

At Sneha Graphics & Solutions, we offer you an assortment of excellent condition machines, from a 4-color offset printing machine to a fully automated and high-caliber printing machine that can align with your business goals and help you take your printing business to a new height of success.

We offer excellent-conditioned and high-performance machines in different dimensions, sizes, and color settings.

What makes us stand out and be a dominating figure in the industry is the fact that we offer robust and optimal conditions for machine machines at an affordable price range. Whether you are looking for an affordable and premium conditioned Komori 5 colour offset printing machine or a top-notch Heildeberg machine at a reasonable pricing range, we have it all for you. Let us know your machinery requirements, and we will be fulfilling them immediately.

Moreover, we provide quality products to our customers despite offering a Mitsubishi 5 color offset printing machine and for other brands at an affordable rate as we believe in providing quality products to our customers without being hard on the pocket. Our team at Sneha Graphics & Solutions ensures to follow a stringent process of quality checks before the product reaches you. So, with us, you can be sure of getting a high-caliber product within your budget. 

Specification Of Our Effective 5-Colour Offset Printing Machine

Impressions: Upto 56 million

Type of Machine: Sheetfed Presses

Year of the Machine: From 1992 to 2002

Brands of Machines: Heidelberg, Komori, Mitsubishi, Adast, Polly, KBA, Polar, Ryobi, Planta, Sypa, Snyder, Wholenburg, and more.

Colour: 5 Colour

Automation: Fully Automatic, and more.

Reach out to us and be sure to get the most high-performing used offset printing machine in the industry in several configurations in colors from 1 to 6 colour variants.

Application of Our Offset Printing Machine:

  • Multi-color printing needs and more.

We have become a dominant player in the interest because we have been providing installation as well as technical support to customers in major cities of India. That includes Delhi NCR, Gujarat, Noida, Jaipur, Rajasthan, Mumbai, Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Kerala, and many other prominent locations in the country. No matter what your location is, we will ensure that we deliver the best product to you.
